mutants.desc: drop file-bytes cap check (unlimited stage size)
mutants.pattern: if \(bytes\.length > attachmentLimits\.fileBytes\) fail\(413, "attachment_too_large", "File exceeds the room attachment size limit"\);

mutants.desc: drop guest denial on stage() (guests can stage files)
mutants.pattern: fail\(403, "guest_scope_denied", "Guest members cannot stage room files"\);

mutants.desc: discard conflict check inverted (throws on success)
mutants.pattern: if \(changed !== 1\) fail\(409, "attachment_conflict", "That attachment changed before it could be discarded"\);
mutants.repl: if (changed !== 0) fail(409, "attachment_conflict", "That attachment changed before it could be discarded");
